purpose: Public-data genotype QC before production-matched ancestry validation; not ancestry accuracy results.
metadata_encoding_reason: Published metadata is not UTF-8; preserve bytes and require ASCII identity fields.
identity_policy: Exclude any alias matching the fixed production imputation reference or any existing ancestry reference, training or development identity. This is necessary but not a completed genotype/relatedness audit.
genotypes: Never use the 2021 release's imputed GT/DS/GP as observed genotypes. Re-call unphased diploid GT from its mpileup PL and AD fields only.
sites: Biallelic A/C/G/T SNPs only. Missing or low-confidence likelihoods remain missing; never fill absent records as homozygous reference.
coordinate_policy: Verify the 2021 likelihood coordinates against the original hs37d5 raw-call control. Require a separate allele/coordinate-validated production-compatible harmonization before ancestry execution.
